_comment: Copy to test-accounts.json and fill in. NEVER commit the filled copy - it is gitignored next to this file, and the campaign's rule is that no credential is ever a tool-call argument, a shell argument or a log line. login.mjs and pin.mjs read this file directly for exactly that reason.

owner.twofa: none, since 2026-09-02 - the campaign signs in through the SERVICE-ACCOUNT link on the login page (PASSWORD_LOGIN_FLOW_SLUG = password-login), whose Authentik flow has no MFA stage. Keep the field: an account that DOES need a code needs somewhere to say how to get one.

peer.twofa: none - same flow as the owner.
